text:
talia-partners: Heads-up: marketplace private-offer batch requires a min-price anchor per HW class and graduated commit discounts. Need to avoid churned renewals from rock-bottom SKUs.

ben-sales: Agree. Propose commit ladder: Y1 22% off, Y2 16%, Y3 10%. Also tie thresholds to committed USD + tokens not raw SKU units.

kiara-gtm: We'll write two FAQ blobs (marketplace listing + private-offer doc) explaining 80/100/120% alerts, 7-day grace, and auto-topup opt-in.

ed-legal: Drafting opt-in language: default OFF for private offers; 7-day grace; disputes filed within 30 days eligible for credit. Need migration-credit clause for big model swaps.

nate-platform: Ops can emit threshold webhooks and optionally throttle burst. We can also support a model-fallback flag (quantized variant) in offer metadata if partner enables it.

marketplace-bot: Validator: include fields commit_terms, auto_topup, min_price_anchor in offer metadata.

kiara-gtm: Action items: Ben -> pricing scenarios, Kiara -> FAQs & listing copy, Ed -> legal text, Nate -> webhook + schema PR. Reconvene after Ben's sheet.

talia-partners: thanks team. :party:
